newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Treasuries narrowly mixed in sluggish Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries narrowly mixed in sluggish Tokyo.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were steady to easier by Tokyo midday on Friday, with light position adjustment sales weighing on mid-term cash Treasury prices.
Tokyo participants took a wait-and-see stance from active trading ahead of the crucial U.S. unemployment data due at 1230 GMT and before the long weekend in Japan, traders said.

"The market is very quiet today ahead of the jobs data," a Japanese brokerage trader said. "The dollar's recent rise above 127 yen has induced some profit-taking by Japanese operators, but they refrained from such selling today after it fell back to around 126.50 yen."

The key 6-5/8 percent 30-year bond stood at 96-8/32, yielding 6.92 percent, compared with 96-11/32 in New York. Traders said that light sales in medium-term cash Treasuries put downward pressure on overall prices in thin trade.
The June T-bond futures contract stood at 109-23/32, up 2/32 from the previous close. A broker said that no major resistance was expected until around 110-5/32.
Traders were looking towards the payroll data to determine whether they should cover their short positions further.
Economists polled by Reuters expected, on average, that non-farm payrolls would rise 211,000 in the April report.
